changes.title: Visible staircase shortcut
changes.text: The staircase shortcut now appears beside the hotbar by default; an explicitly disabled preference stays disabled.

changes.title: Find stair controls
changes.text: Enabling Automatic Stair Navigation explains where to tap for Stairs Up and Stairs Down.

changes.title: Default stair-control regression
changes.text: Added preference reload checks and a native dungeon test that opens the shortcut without force-enabling it.

changes.title: Chalice damage preview
changes.text: Chalice inspection and confirmation show the next prick's base damage, full reduced range, HP loss after shields and current HP.

changes.title: Current defenses and fatal warning
changes.text: The warning considers temporary defenses, Antimagic, Cape activation and the Warrior's shield; Life Link is explicitly marked unpredictable.

changes.title: Damage and native rendering regressions
changes.text: Added Chalice range, actual-damage, save and RNG checks, corrected the stair-default expectation and required an Android item-window screenshot.

changes.title: Accurate build preparation records
changes.text: Recorded the failed TEST84 attempt, successful preceding verification and the new preview's mechanics and limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I made the staircase shortcut easier to discover and added a Chalice preview that uses your current defenses. It warns about the worst outcome rather than suggesting an average hit is safe.
